title: Finite convex interpolation for polynomial Lyapunov existence
author: Lluis Eriksson

importance_anchors.10: unconditional recognized Millennium problem with extraordinary independent verification

score_basis.technical_quality: Complete integrated arguments preserve strictification, singular interpolation, quantifier scope and suprema; new complexity proof controls rational inner/outer radii, exact constant cancellation, repeated-root residues and bit encoding. Angular-zero obstruction controls boundary factors and C1 stability. Exact examples and reproducible diagnostic evidence are cleanly distinguished. No blocking defect found. Not formal verification or an implemented general certified solver.
score_basis.importance: Exceptional all-degree characterization with finite convex interpolation, exact boundary decision and a uniform coefficient region, now with polynomial-time additive/gap reduction for dense rational fields and a full-dimensional angular-zero counterexample box.
score_basis.limits_on_importance: Restricted planar homogeneous class; no general angular-zero classification, efficient equality claim, polynomial-sized certificate output, demonstrated broad practical impact or exhaustive worldwide-priority validation. Classical interpolation/GLS/root algorithms remain prior ingredients.
score_basis.fresh_assessment_scope: Entire exact20-page manuscript read and viewed afresh. Scores reconsidered on this artifact; equality with an earlier9/7 is not transfer or another independent vote. Proposals39/40 excluded.
